# epsg

EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset

## Index

| Operation              | Description                           
|------------------------|---------------------------------------
| [`epsg.utm`](#epsgutm) | Universal Transverse Mercator (WGS-84)

| Name                | Value         | Description                             
|---------------------|---------------|-----------------------------------------
| `epsg.web-mercator` | `'EPSG:3857'` | Web Mercator, EPSG:3857                 
| `epsg.wgs-84`       | `'EPSG:4326'` | World Geodetic System of 1984, EPSG:4326


## Operations

### epsg.utm

The EPGS code for the given UTM zone *x*. The zone should be a number
between 1 and 60 inclusive and followed by a hemisphere designator of
'n' or 's'.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Text -- Text )
```

Example:

| Input          | Stack       
|----------------|-------------
| `17n epsg.utm` | `EPSG:32617`
